ritz_numeric_rules.SVD: Thin SVD of full B=N x k. Keep sigma_i >64 eps max(N,k) sigma_max. No ridge, inverse, gap truth, parameter search. Cache one factor per distinct nonzero k_m.
ritz_numeric_rules.cold_replay: One complete independent replay: rebuild basis, PF block/echo backend, states, factors, all signed proxies; no cache shared across passes. Local identical S2 block cache inside one build retained. Count all repeat operations.
ritz_numeric_rules.initial_rank_threshold: 64 eps N max(||Hpsi||,|E|,tiny); reject norm <= threshold
ritz_numeric_rules.noise_rule: eta=max(||U†U-I||_F/|t|, |g_full_replay-g_first|,50 eps max(||H||_2,1/|t|)); same formula per arm, no truth in eta. Response conditioning/roundoff diagnostics separately reported, not a bias certificate.
ritz_numeric_rules.nonfinite_policy: Stop affected run before interpretation on any nonfinite coefficient, vector, residual or proxy. Zero-rank response is z=0 and Ritz original psi, reuse baseline.
ritz_numeric_rules.orthogonality_gate: ||Z†Z-I||_F and ||psi†Z||_2 <=64 eps N; failure stops, no extra passes.
ritz_numeric_rules.orthogonalization: Exactly two modified Gram-Schmidt passes; project against psi before each pass, then sequential accepted columns. Largest-magnitude component phase made positive, first index wins ties.
ritz_numeric_rules.projected_hermiticity_gate: ||H_m-H_m†||_F <=64 eps N max(||H_m||_F,tiny); symmetrize only within this gate.
ritz_numeric_rules.rank_stop: Stop at first rejected direction, use identical retained prefix for all arms/m; no replacement directions or increased m. k_m=min(m,k_max).
ritz_numeric_rules.relative_residual_denominator: max(||a||,epsilon_num), epsilon_num=64 eps N max(||a||,1 Ha); fixed units Ha.
ritz_numeric_rules.residual_convergence: For each of 22 signed coordinates and consecutive m, d_next<=d_prev+eta_prev+eta_next, eta_m=64 eps N(||a||+||B_m||_F||c_m||). All comparisons must pass for Outcome A. Cutoff changes may break monotonicity; record failure, never tune cutoff.
ritz_numeric_rules.rho_quality: rho=abs(g)/max(eta,1e-300); resolved>=100, marginal>=10, unresolved otherwise; applies to each arm. No post-hoc rescue.
ritz_numeric_rules.ritz_tie_rule: lowest projected eigenspace within 64 eps dim(H_m)||H_m||_2; project e0 then e1,... until norm>64 eps dim(H_m), normalize, fix largest-component phase.
